title: Heart failure predicted effector genes (Levin MG et al. 2022)
bodyHtml:
This table displays results from the study:

Genome-wide association and multi-trait analyses characterize the common genetic architecture of heart failure.
Levin MG et al.
Nat Commun. 2022 Nov 14;13(1):6914. doi: 10.1038/s41467-022-34216-6.
PMID: 36376295

The authors performed a GWAS meta-analysis of all-cause heart failure in a trans-ancestry population of 115,150 cases and 1,550,331 controls. They then generated five lines of evidence to prioritize genes at GWAS significant loci. Mouse over the column headers in the table below for explanations of each evidence type.
